item.mc_assistant.garment.worn.head: A hat, worn off work
item.mc_assistant.spectacles.desc: Gold wire and two panes of glass. Hand them to an old folk who has none.
talk.mc_assistant.cat.chat.tip: Pass the time of day: how it is, the news, gossip, a joke, a kind word
talk.mc_assistant.cat.about.tip: Its life: itself, its family, its hopes, its home, its work
talk.mc_assistant.cat.ask.tip: Favours, errands and quests; its company on a walk or an adventure
talk.mc_assistant.cat.trade.tip: Gifts, buying and selling, money, houses and services
talk.mc_assistant.cat.town.tip: The town's ways and people, its council and elections, the law and the records
talk.mc_assistant.cat.world.tip: The neighbours, what the scouts, the cave team and the Nether runners found, and maps
talk.mc_assistant.how.tip: Ask how it is, and why
talk.mc_assistant.news.tip: What has been happening in the village
talk.mc_assistant.gossip.tip: Who is up to what: what it has heard
talk.mc_assistant.praise.tip: Tell it it's doing a fine job: it will warm to you
talk.mc_assistant.chat_more.tip: What it is doing, its pastimes, fashion, a meal or a game of dice, an apology
talk.mc_assistant.doing.tip: What it is up to just now, and why
talk.mc_assistant.fashion.tip: What the town is wearing this season, who set it, and what this folk thinks of it
talk.mc_assistant.meal.tip: Share the food in your hand: it eats with you, and likes you the better
talk.mc_assistant.dice.tip: A game of dice for three coins, out of each other's purses (type "dice for 10" to raise it)
talk.mc_assistant.about.tip: Ask it to tell you about itself
talk.mc_assistant.people.tip: Its family, its friends, who it can't stand
talk.mc_assistant.home.tip: Where it lives, its pet, a keepsake; a godparent for a child
talk.mc_assistant.house.tip: Where it lives, who with, and whether the house is its own
talk.mc_assistant.pet.tip: Its household's dog or cat: how it is, what it gets up to; a pup or a kitten looking for a home
talk.mc_assistant.keepsake.tip: A close friend gives you something of its own to remember it by
talk.mc_assistant.godparent.tip: Ask a child if you may be its godparent (a friend of the village only)
talk.mc_assistant.work.tip: Its trade, what it is good at, what it earns; a lesson either way
talk.mc_assistant.workings.tip: How its work goes: tools, where it works, what it needs, where its work goes
talk.mc_assistant.knack.tip: Its level in every trade it has worked, how its nature suits its work, and the knacks it chose
talk.mc_assistant.worth.tip: What it earns and what it is worth
talk.mc_assistant.teach.tip: Show it a trick of its trade with the tool of it in your hand: once a day, it learns
talk.mc_assistant.apprentice.tip: Learn its trade (a master of level 25 or more): lessons that open recipes, bonuses and titles
talk.mc_assistant.lesson.tip: Your master's next lesson, or your journal of what you are learning; hand over what it asked for
talk.mc_assistant.profile.tip: Its card: trade and levels, wage, home, family, nature, and what it is busy with
talk.mc_assistant.skills.tip: Its knack points, its trades' levels, the knacks it chose and the ones still open to it
talk.mc_assistant.record.tip: Its whole life on one screen: who it is, its family and home, its work, its day and its belongings
talk.mc_assistant.jobs.tip: Ask if it has a quest for you: a favour of its own, the town's work, the war's, the caves', a story
talk.mc_assistant.help.tip: Ask if there's an errand you could run for it
talk.mc_assistant.follow.tip: Ask it to walk with you
talk.mc_assistant.stay.tip: Let it go back to its day
talk.mc_assistant.guide.tip: Ask it to walk you somewhere: the stores, the board, the elder, any building
talk.mc_assistant.hire.tip: Four coins a day: it goes with you, fights for you, carries for you
talk.mc_assistant.favours.tip: A favour, what the village is short of, the lost and found, the elder's orders, the quest board
talk.mc_assistant.shifts.tip: Paid work in town: ask the boss of a job twice to take a shift
talk.mc_assistant.short.tip: What the village is short of, and how you could help
talk.mc_assistant.lost.tip: Anything of yours the sweeper found lying in the streets, kept for you in the Lost and Found by the storehouse
talk.mc_assistant.orders.tip: What the elder wants the village to put its back into
talk.mc_assistant.quests.tip: What the village wants done, and what it pays
talk.mc_assistant.gift.tip: Give it what you are holding
talk.mc_assistant.deliver.tip: Give it what it asked you for, or pay for what it offered
talk.mc_assistant.trade.tip: Ask if it has anything to trade
talk.mc_assistant.shop.tip: What's for sale, the stores, orders, making and mending, haggling, rockets
talk.mc_assistant.for_sale.tip: What the village can spare, and at what price: it sees to itself first
talk.mc_assistant.stores.tip: Ask the storekeeper for something: type what and how many
talk.mc_assistant.bulk.tip: Order a quantity of anything at a tenth off: type what and how many
talk.mc_assistant.make.tip: Ask a smith or a tailor to make you something: from your makings and the village's spare, for a fee
talk.mc_assistant.repair.tip: The smith (or, with no smith, a smelter at its forge) mends the worn thing in your hand: its metal from the stores at the market's price, and a fee
talk.mc_assistant.see_to.tip: The healer sees to your hurts: a bandage you hold for a small fee, else the best remedy in the stores at the market's price and the fee; a rest and a kind word for a coin when the stores are bare
talk.mc_assistant.farm_growing.tip: The farmer tells what is up in its field and how much is ripe, the season, and what the town could spare to sell
talk.mc_assistant.farm_produce.tip: A lot of the fields' produce out of the stores at the town's price: say what and how many, or take what the town can best spare
talk.mc_assistant.wood_timber.tip: Logs in bulk from the woodcutter, a tenth off: at once if the town can spare them, else a quarter down and the rest within the week
talk.mc_assistant.fish_buy.tip: Cod or salmon out of the stores, at the town's price
talk.mc_assistant.fish_boat.tip: A seat in the fisher's boat when the fleet next goes out: be by its boat at the quay at first light
talk.mc_assistant.hunt_go.tip: The hunter hunts wherever you lead till the morning's done, and half the meat is yours. Never a herd's beast, never the last of a kind
talk.mc_assistant.hunt_hides.tip: Leather, feathers or rabbit hide out of the stores, at the town's price
talk.mc_assistant.ranch_wool.tip: Wool off the town's sheep, out of the stores, at the town's price
talk.mc_assistant.ranch_horse.tip: One of the town's broken horses, led off on a lead, its saddle with it: never the last two the couriers ride
talk.mc_assistant.ferry_across.tip: Rowed over the water now, or the boat called to your side: a coin a crossing, paid on the far landing
talk.mc_assistant.golem_order.tip: An iron golem stood up beside you from your own four blocks of iron and a pumpkin, for the keeper's fee. Lead it home
talk.mc_assistant.lamp_street.tip: The engineer puts a lamp that lights itself at dusk on the town's post nearest you: its fee from you, the parts from the stores
talk.mc_assistant.emerald_sells.tip: What the emerald trader has found on the villagers' stalls, and where
talk.mc_assistant.emerald_ask.tip: Put something on the trader's buying list for its next trip to the villagers: a book, a bell, a map
talk.mc_assistant.diver_clay.tip: The diver brings up clay or sea pickles from the bed for you, paid when you collect
talk.mc_assistant.diver_ready.tip: Collect what the diver brought up for you, and pay for it
talk.mc_assistant.mine_ore.tip: Coal or raw iron, copper and gold up from the mine, out of the stores at the town's price
talk.mc_assistant.fletcher_arrows.tip: Arrows of the fletcher's making, out of the stores at the town's price: what the town can spare
talk.mc_assistant.haggle.tip: Ask the storekeeper or the shopkeeper to do it cheaper: a discount for the day, if they like you
talk.mc_assistant.rockets.tip: Rockets to fly with, eight to a lot, from the fireworks maker at its powder hut or the shop. Say "flight two" or "flight three" for the longer ones
talk.mc_assistant.money.tip: The bank, investing, a supply contract, a stall, the auction, prices
talk.mc_assistant.bank.tip: Your account: "deposit 20", "withdraw 10", "a mortgage on this house" standing in an empty one; "borrow 30", "repay" for the treasury's small loans
talk.mc_assistant.invest.tip: Put coin into the village's works: two weeks' share of what it takes each day
talk.mc_assistant.contract.tip: Bring the village what it is short of every week, at a third over its worth (say "I'll sign")
talk.mc_assistant.stall.tip: A stall of your own on the square, a week at a time: stock it, set your prices, and the folk buy from it. Ask again for how it's doing, "take the till" or "pay the rent"
talk.mc_assistant.auction.tip: Market day's auction: the lots, the bids, your own goods put up ("I bid 30", "put it up")
talk.mc_assistant.prices.tip: Where things are dear and where cheap, round about: buy cheap, sell dear
talk.mc_assistant.services.tip: A house to buy or built for you, a feast for the town, a caravan to guard, a trade route
talk.mc_assistant.housing.tip: The village's empty houses and their prices. Say "buy this house" standing in one, "let my house for 3", or "my rent"
talk.mc_assistant.commission.tip: Bring 64 planks, 32 cobblestone and 8 glass, and the builders put up a house for you
talk.mc_assistant.sponsor.tip: Pay for a feast for the whole village tonight: ten coins and one for every mouth
talk.mc_assistant.escort.tip: Guard the next caravan: walk with it and be paid at the other end
talk.mc_assistant.charter.tip: Fifty coins for a trade route to the nearest neighbour: a tenth of every load sold on it is yours
talk.mc_assistant.ways.tip: Its character, who rules it, its laws, what it is famous for and what history has made of it, in this folk's own words
talk.mc_assistant.repute.tip: What people think of you here
talk.mc_assistant.council_group.tip: The council, a building suggested, citizenship, interviews, elections and the leader's page
talk.mc_assistant.council.tip: Who sits on the council, and what it voted. Say "you should build a tavern" to put it to the vote
talk.mc_assistant.build.tip: Type what you think the village should build next
talk.mc_assistant.citizen.tip: Ask to become a citizen: a vote on the council and a house of your own
talk.mc_assistant.interviews.tip: Who stands for which post at the town's interviews, and when. Then type "I'd recommend <name> for the post" to put in a good word
talk.mc_assistant.stand.tip: Put your name forward at the next election (a citizen the town counts a friend, at the board or the hall)
talk.mc_assistant.vote.tip: Canvass: it weighs what you stand for against what it cares for
talk.mc_assistant.leader.tip: Your promises and powers, or the hustings if you don't lead
talk.mc_assistant.law.tip: What it saw, a crime reported, the roster, being sworn in, a fine paid
talk.mc_assistant.watch.tip: A theft or a vandal: ask what it saw. To a guard: the case it is on; hold what was dropped at the scene to hand it in, or type "I saw Fen take it"
talk.mc_assistant.report.tip: Tell a guard (or the desk at the watch house) what you saw: it goes on the books and the watch goes at a run
talk.mc_assistant.roster.tip: Who of the watch is on the walls, the beat, the desk and the cases today, and who drew it
talk.mc_assistant.swear.tip: A citizen or a friend of the town with a clean record can be sworn in as a special constable: a badge, arrests, the beat, and a wage for every case closed
talk.mc_assistant.fine.tip: Pay what you owe the village
talk.mc_assistant.records.tip: The village board, the town ledger, the chronicle, the next fireworks
talk.mc_assistant.board.tip: Read the village board: what it is doing, how it is getting on, what it is working towards
talk.mc_assistant.ledger.tip: A book of the village's affairs
talk.mc_assistant.chronicle.tip: Ask for a copy of the village's chronicle
talk.mc_assistant.fireworks.tip: The town's next display, and the rockets it has ready
talk.mc_assistant.rivals.tip: What this village thinks of the villages round about, who leads them, and who trades with whom
talk.mc_assistant.letter.tip: Take a letter from the elder to the nearest neighbour's: both villages will think the better of you, and of each other
talk.mc_assistant.atlas.tip: What the village's scouts have found: towns, ruins, peaks, ore, and which way
talk.mc_assistant.caves.tip: The cave team's finds; with the team itself, an ask, a trip along and its map
talk.mc_assistant.caves_report.tip: What the town's cave dwellers have found: caves, ore, mineshafts, spawners, old chests, and where
talk.mc_assistant.caves_ask.tip: Ask the cave team to look a way or find something on its next trip: type it ("look east", "find us diamonds")
talk.mc_assistant.caves_go.tip: Go down the caves with the cave team: it waits for you at its lodge at first light. Say "for a share" to take a share of the haul
talk.mc_assistant.caves_map.tip: A copy of the cave team's map, every cave it has found marked: a few coins
talk.mc_assistant.nether.tip: The Nether runners' report; with a runner, an ask, a trip through and their chart
talk.mc_assistant.nether_report.tip: What the town's Nether runners have found through the gateway: the outpost, the fortress, the hauls
talk.mc_assistant.nether_ask.tip: Ask the Nether runners to bring something on their next run: type it ("bring us blaze rods")
talk.mc_assistant.nether_go.tip: Go through the gateway with the Nether runners: they wait for you there in the morning. Say "for a share" to take a share of the haul
talk.mc_assistant.nether_chart.tip: A copy of the runners' chart of the Nether round their outpost, their finds marked: a few coins
talk.mc_assistant.maps_group.tip: The town map, the cartographer's maps, explorer and treasure maps, a map made to order
talk.mc_assistant.maps.tip: The cartographer's maps and their prices: explorer maps, a copy of the hall's map, a map to any place the town knows of
talk.mc_assistant.town_map.tip: A map of the town, centred on its heart: for citizens and honoured guests, from the storekeeper, the elder or the cartographer, one a day
talk.mc_assistant.map_ocean.tip: A real ocean explorer map to the nearest monument the town's land reaches: priced by how far
talk.mc_assistant.map_woodland.tip: A real woodland explorer map to a mansion, if the town's scouts have been that far
talk.mc_assistant.map_treasure.tip: A buried treasure map: one the town brought home from a wreck, or treasure it found itself
talk.mc_assistant.map_copy.tip: Every sheet of the hall's map of the town, copied for you: hang them as they hang in the hall
talk.mc_assistant.map_commission.tip: Have the cartographer walk and draw the land any way you like, ready by nightfall: type "map me the land to the east"
talk.mc_assistant.birthday.tip: It's its birthday today: give it what you are holding, and it will remember it
talk.mc_assistant.ui.back_tip: Back up a level (Esc or Backspace)
talk.mc_assistant.ui.say_empty: Type something to say first (T or Enter to start typing)
talk.mc_assistant.ui.hint: Say anything… ("show me the café", "8 bread, please?")
talk.mc_assistant.ui.empty: Pick a topic on the left (or press 1-9), or type below to say anything at all.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.empty_category: Nothing here applies to this folk just now.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.places_empty: It knows of nowhere it could show you yet.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.profile_empty: It has not said much about itself yet.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.skills_empty: It has said nothing yet of what it is good at.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.why.gift: Hold what you want to give.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.why.deliver: You don't have what it asked for yet.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.why.repair: Hold the worn thing you want mended.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.why.teach: Hold a tool of its trade.
talk.mc_assistant.ui.why.shunned: The town has turned against you: only a gift, or paying what you owe, will be heard.
